title: Nice set but no heat rating for included utensils & FORC label is upside down on mat
text:
Nice set but no heat rating for included utensils & FORC label is upside down on mat. This all silicone set comes with a mat that has an embedded spoon rest and slots for holding five utensils. There are also four utensils included. However, there is no heat rating written anywhere for the four utensils; therefore, I have no idea if the utensils will melt at certain temperatures. This is a big negative to me.

Second, the placement of the FORC label on the mat is upside down in the upper right corner--see PHOTO. This is sort of a non-issue but it is a detail that should be corrected.

The mat has a small lip around the edge that will keep water or liquids from running over the sides, which is great.

I love the color of this mat and its versatility. It is certainly very functional.

I have no idea how much this will be priced at but anything more than $12 in its current state would be overpriced in my opinion.
